content.test_md_blob:
# Hide and restore the Allocation section from Customize

> Prove a standard card section can be hidden, the surrounding layout closes the gap, and the section returns when re-enabled.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a browser and wait for the ORBITAL dashboard to finish rendering with both the Portfolio Performance and Allocation sections visible in the first row.

## Step 2

Open the Customize control and keep the right-side drawer visible while working with the section toggles.

## Step 3

In the Customize drawer's Display section toggles, clear the Allocation option.

## Step 4

Assert that the Allocation section is no longer shown on the dashboard.

## Step 5

Assert that the surrounding dashboard layout has reflowed and there is no empty dashboard slot where the disabled section had been.

## Step 6

In the same Customize drawer, enable the Allocation option again.

## Step 7

Assert that the Allocation section is visible on the dashboard again.

## Step 8 — assert @verifies ac-128, ac-135, ac-136, ac-137

Confirm 'an empty dashboard slot where the disabled section had been' does NOT appear (forbidden-presence) — the stated promise: After a section is disabled, the surrounding dashboard layout reflows without leaving the removed section's slot empty.
